desc:
>> Deepwoken is a difficult game with permanent character loss. Losing characters is a part of the game that should be expected. <<

In Deepwoken, every story is yours to tell. Though, however short they may be is up to you. Arm yourself with a selection of hundreds of unique abilities. Plunder and forge a vast array of weapons, armor, and equipment. Fight and overcome the odds, clawing your way back from every defeat.

Explore Lumen, a fragmented world that spans hostile waters, bustling towns, ruined sanctuaries, and nightmarish geometries. Delve through a variety of challenging dungeons, and test your might in PvP.

Uncover the mysteries of a dying world with hundreds of characters and an in-game glossary that expands with every new piece of lore uncovered.

Build your character with a range of origins, attributes, upgrades, and drip yourself out with a variety of customisation options.

---

Winner of "Best New Experience" Innovation Awards '22

badges.name: Oathsworn
badges.desc: Swear an Oath. An indescribable power emanates from words spoken from the soul. You now wield it.

badges.name: Maximum Power
badges.desc:
You've reached Power 20, the pinnacle of your natural abilities. But perhaps there are further ways to gain strength?

Grants a free Character Slot.

badges.name: Soul Resonance
badges.desc: Your soul has resonated with the Song, now producing its own distinct Tone. This resonance has manifested as the instrument now kept at your hip.

badges.name: Trial of One
badges.desc: Complete the Trial of One. Could you be the One we've been searching for?

badges.name: Chain of Perfection
badges.desc: Defeat a formidable foe on your own without taking any damage. Unlocks the Echo Talent "Chain of Perfection".

badges.name: A Rank
badges.desc:
Achieve an A Rank Legacy. A life that was truly worth living.

Grants a free Character Slot.

badges.name: S Rank
badges.desc: Achieve an S Rank Legacy. Every title, every accolade - all beneath you now.

badges.name: W Rank
badges.desc: Achieve a W Rank Legacy. No shadows can dim your light.

badges.name: Memory Surpassed
badges.desc:
Defeat the Fourth Prophet in the Vow of Iron.

Grants a free Character Slot.
